_comment: One entry per Connect IQ store listing. The map is compiled into the app,
so a listing covers exactly one region and carries street-level detail the
downloadable catalogue cannot: see docs/CITIES.md for that trade.
app_id is THIS LISTING's identity and MUST NOT change once published: a new
id is a new listing with no users and no ratings. It is deliberately not
the id in manifest.xml, which belongs to the one-app-many-cities build that
is already on the store. Generate one with:
products is the watches this listing covers, and it is not optional for a
dense city. The store rejects a .iq over 15 MB and the map is compiled into
every product, so the usable pack is 15 MB divided by their number. Berlin
at street level is ~2.7 MB per watch: five fit, twenty-four do not.
bbox is west,south,east,north. tools/build-city.sh fails the build if the

berlin.note: Inside the Ringbahn. Dense: needs the tighter point budget to keep the renderer from truncating before it covers the screen.
